subject: ISV catalog / runtime connector: sandbox + onboarding
messages:
From: Elliott Walker <elliott@convergent.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Integrating Convergent runtime into Redwood ISV catalog (POC scope)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro at KubeCon — we had a great follow-up discussion internally and Convergent is excited to move forward with a short POC to validate our runtime connector can be surfaced in Redwood's ISV catalog and sandbox.

High-level ask: can Redwood provide a sandbox runtime slot + catalog entry so customers can try Convergent’s "fast-kv" runtime via the Redwood API? We expect this to be a 3-week technical POC:
- Week 0: sandbox access + contract/NDAs finalized
- Week 1: connector deploy + smoke tests (token routing, model variant fallback)
- Week 2: performance verification & docs for catalog listing

Attached a brief POC-scope.pdf with success criteria and a proposed mutual action plan.

Dependencies we know about: the sandbox needs a short-lived service account and a small VPC peering rule; we can support a containerized connector and provide tracing hooks that send telemetry to Redwood tracing endpoints (we can adapt to your tracing schema).

Are you available next week for a 30-min kickoff? Suggested slots: Tue 9/7 or Thu 9/9 in the morning PT.

Thanks,
Elliott Walker
Head of Partnerships, Convergent AI
E: elliott@convergent.ai
A: Convergent AI

Attachment: POC-scope.pdf (1 page stub)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Elliott Walker <elliott@convergent.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integrating Convergent runtime into Redwood ISV catalog (POC scope)

Thanks Elliott — great to hear the kickoff momentum. Looping in Marissa (ISV integrations) and Jonas (partner ops) to own the technical onboarding.

High level next steps from Redwood side:
1) Exchange NDAs/contract addendum (ops) — I'll send a short partner MOU template to streamline this.
2) Sandbox access: we can provision a 2-week sandbox runtime instance (non-prod) and a catalog preview entry. We need your connector image and a short compatibility README.
3) Security checks: please complete our lightweight security intake so we can pre-clear the connector for runtime access.
4) Kickoff slot: Tue 9/7 10:00am PT works for me — Marissa / Jonas, can you confirm?

Success criteria alignment: as written in your POC-scope.pdf but to be explicit: catalog listing that routes to Convergent runtime via Redwood API, a passing smoke test (latency SLA agreed in doc), and a small sample doc for customers.

Marissa — can you draft the sandbox checklist and include the tracing endpoint expectations? Jonas — I'll need a short note from partner ops on required billing/trial entitlements so Convergent can test with a demo tenant.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 15:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integrating Convergent runtime into Redwood ISV catalog (POC scope)

Elliott / team — thanks, this looks straightforward. I put together a quick sandbox-setup-checklist.xlsx (stub) and internal runbook notes below.

Sandbox checklist (summary):
- Service account: create redwood-isv-convergent-test@[redwood-sandbox] with short-lived key (we'll rotate after POC)
- Connector artifact: container image (OCI) + image pull secret; must support token-based auth to Redwood routing layer
- Open ports: 443 only + optional tracing TCP/HTTP endpoint (we accept OTLP over HTTP)
- Tracing: send spans to https://tracing.redwood.ai/collector/partner (we'll provide a per-partner ingestion key)
- KV test harness: we'll run a 5k-key synthetic workload and capture p95/p99 latency
- Catalog metadata: short description (<= 200 chars), icons, and runtime capability tags (e.g., kv-store, low-latency)

Proposed timeline (we can compress if your team is ready):
- Mon 9/6: exchange MOU + security intake link
- Tue 9/7: provisioning + kickoff meeting (10:00am PT)
- Wed 9/8 - Mon 9/13: connector deploy + smoke tests
- Tue 9/14: performance verification + catalog preview publish

Security intake: please fill the short questionnaire at https://redwood.ai/partner-intake (we just need basic architecture and SOC2 attestation). If you have a SOC2 excerpt, you can upload that — it speeds approval.

I'll attach the checklist to the HubSpot deal and link the runbook.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
ISV Integrations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: sandbox-setup-checklist.xlsx (stub)
